sources.title: What is Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus?
Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus pricing

en.summary: A serverless monitoring service compatible with Prometheus for metrics from container environments, such as Amazon EKS and self-managed Kubernetes. It uses the same Prometheus data model and PromQL query language, and scales ingestion, storage and queries automatically.
examCues: Monitor metrics from EKS or Kubernetes clusters with PromQL without running Prometheus servers → Managed Service for Prometheus
Keep container metrics in a highly available store that replicates data across three Availability Zones → Managed Service for Prometheus

notToConfuseWith.difference: Managed Grafana shows dashboards; Managed Service for Prometheus collects, stores and queries the metrics behind them.
CloudWatch is the AWS monitoring service for metrics, logs and alarms across AWS resources; Managed Service for Prometheus uses the open-source Prometheus data model and PromQL.

en.pricingModel: You pay for the metric samples ingested, the metrics stored and the query samples processed, plus the hours and samples of the managed collector if you use it. A free tier covers some ingestion, queries and storage.

aws: Scales ingestion, storage and queries, and replicates data across three Availability Zones
customer: Chooses which metrics to send and how long to keep them
Writes the queries and alerting rules and controls access to the workspace

es.summary: Un servicio de monitoreo serverless compatible con Prometheus para métricas de entornos de contenedores, como Amazon EKS y Kubernetes autoadministrado. Usa el mismo modelo de datos de Prometheus y el lenguaje de consultas PromQL, y escala la ingesta, el almacenamiento y las consultas de forma automática.
examCues: Monitorear métricas de clústeres de EKS o Kubernetes con PromQL sin operar servidores de Prometheus → Managed Service for Prometheus
Guardar métricas de contenedores en un almacén de alta disponibilidad que replica los datos en tres Availability Zones → Managed Service for Prometheus

notToConfuseWith.difference: Managed Grafana muestra dashboards; Managed Service for Prometheus recopila, guarda y consulta las métricas que hay detrás.
CloudWatch es el servicio de monitoreo de AWS para métricas, logs y alarmas de los recursos de AWS; Managed Service for Prometheus usa el modelo de datos open source de Prometheus y PromQL.

es.pricingModel: Pagas por las muestras de métricas ingeridas, las métricas guardadas y las muestras procesadas por consultas, más las horas y muestras del recolector administrado si lo usas. Un free tier cubre parte de la ingesta, las consultas y el almacenamiento.

aws: Escala la ingesta, el almacenamiento y las consultas, y replica los datos en tres Availability Zones
customer: Elige qué métricas enviar y cuánto tiempo guardarlas
Escribe las consultas y las reglas de alerta y controla el acceso al workspace
